sources.publisher: Badan Pengembangan dan Pembinaan Bahasa, Indonesia
sources.observation: The Indonesian dictionary defines a post-office box as a box at a kantor pos, supporting the building/institution sense of kantor pos.
sources.limitations: A definition example does not independently establish preferred everyday wording.

sources.page_location_or_query: 2024 annual-report profile excerpt, PDF pages 2-3, lines 108-111 and 153-158
sources.observation: The national postal operator counts more than four thousand of its own branches as Kantor pos, using that as the standard institutional label.
sources.limitations: Corporate institutional naming is a strong usage signal for postal facilities but is not a conversational frequency study.

sources.observation: The DBP terminology table lists Indonesian kantor pos and Malaysian pejabat pos within the post office protocol compound.
sources.limitations: This is the same underlying DBP source group as the Malaysian entry; the term is embedded in a technical compound and needs independent everyday-context corroboration.

sources.page_location_or_query: Citizen instructions for postal-counter purchases, lines 0-9
sources.observation: The local government tells residents to go to the nearest kantor pos for stamps or duty stamps, using the phrase in ordinary public instructions.
sources.limitations: A city service instruction supplies practical-context usage, not a frequency estimate or categorical absence of synonyms.

sources.page_location_or_query: Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan, lines 11-16; MABBIM table, lines 24-25; terminology, lines 29-38
sources.observation: DBP translates the ordinary post office noun as pejabat pos and its Indonesia/Malaysia MABBIM terminology table contrasts Indonesian kantor pos with Malaysian pejabat pos within a technical compound.
sources.limitations: The Indonesian/Malaysian contrast in the table is for post office protocol, a technical compound; dictionary translation alone does not measure conversational frequency.

sources.page_location_or_query: Personalised Stamps terms, PDF page 2, lines 60-63
sources.observation: The Malaysian postal operator names its Kuala Lumpur main post-office building Pejabat Pos Besar Kuala Lumpur.
sources.limitations: The named main building demonstrates normal institutional use but does not quantify everyday speech.

sources.page_location_or_query: Search-index excerpt of postal/courier statistics book, heading PEJABAT POS
sources.observation: The indexed regulator report uses pejabat pos as a heading for post offices.
sources.limitations: Only an indexed excerpt was inspected; the report is older and this does not prove everyday frequency.
